name: prof-openloop-180
description: Hold-ratchet discriminator: pure OpenLoop drive at the 180 rad/s el handoff velocity, 0.3 A, ~8 s — the same operating point as the startup hold but with NO confirm probes and no startup machinery. If the parallel observer still ratchets away (watch the 2 Hz 'obs:' trace), the divergence is continuous (lambda tracker / clamp artifact / R mismatch class); if it tracks ~180, the probes themselves pump it (probe-exit transient class).
